explanation_templates.high_confidence_authentic: This certificate structure and institution patterns appear consistent with authentic documents from {institution}.
explanation_templates.moderate_confidence_flag: This document has some minor inconsistencies that warrant attention: {specific_issues}.
explanation_templates.high_suspicion_signature: Possible manipulation detected near the signature area. The signature shows {specific_indicators}.
explanation_templates.low_ocr_quality: Poor OCR consistency suggests possible image quality issues or tampering affecting readability of {field}.
explanation_templates.institution_confident: Institution ({institution}) structure strongly matches known patterns with {matching_fields}.
explanation_templates.institution_not_recognized: Institution name '{institution}' not found in current database. This may indicate a lesser-known institution, spelling variation, or potential forgery.
explanation_templates.layout_mismatch: The document layout differs from known authentic certificate structures for {document_type}.
explanation_templates.duplicated_region: Possible duplicated or copied image regions were detected in the {region} area.
explanation_templates.likely_authentic: The certificate structure, institution validation, date consistency, and security features all appear consistent.
explanation_templates.future_date_detected: Certificate has an issue: the award date ({date}) is in the future, which is impossible.
explanation_templates.temporal_inconsistency: Timeline inconsistency detected: {institution} was founded in {year}, but this certificate is dated {earlier_date}.
explanation_templates.missing_security_feature: Expected security feature '{feature}' is missing from this certificate type.
explanation_templates.requires_manual_review: This document requires manual review and direct verification with {institution}.
